class.name: TamaManager
class.brief_description: Engine singleton that manages bullet pattern scripts, bullet type registration, and global state for Tama.
class.description:
[b]TamaManager[/b] is the central singleton for the Tama bullet hell framework. Access it via [code]TamaManager[/code] in GDScript.
Before any emitters can fire, you must load TamaScript files and register at least one bullet type. A minimal setup looks like: [codeblock] func _ready(): TamaManager.load_scripts() # loads from tama/scripts_path project setting TamaManager.register_server_bullet("default", preload("res://bullets/my_config.tres")) [/codeblock]
[b]Script loading[/b] reads [code].tama[/code] files from the directory configured in [code]tama/scripts_path[/code] (default: [code]res://tamascripts[/code]). Individual scripts can also be loaded by name/path or injected directly from source strings.
[b]Bullet types[/b] come in two flavours: - [i]Server bullets[/i] (registered with [method register_server_bullet]) use MultiMesh batching and physics-server collision. They are the high-performance path for large numbers of bullets. - [i]Scene bullets[/i] (registered with [method register_bullet]) instantiate a [PackedScene] per bullet, giving full scene-graph flexibility at a higher per-bullet cost.
The [member player_position] property must be updated every frame so that [code]aim[/code] direction directives in TamaScript resolve correctly.

method.name: load_scripts
method.description: Loads all [code].tama[/code] files found in [param path]. If [param path] is empty, the directory configured in the [code]tama/scripts_path[/code] project setting is used (default: [code]res://tamascripts[/code]).

method.name: load_script
method.description: Loads a single TamaScript file. [param filename] is the bare name used to reference the script (e.g. [code]"spiral"[/code]); [param full_path] is the resource path to the file.

method.name: load_script_from_source
method.description: Parses and registers a TamaScript directly from a source string. Useful for procedurally generated or runtime-defined patterns.

method.name: register_bullet
method.description: Registers a scene-based bullet type under [param type]. [TamaEmitter] nodes that reference this type will instantiate [param scene] for each bullet fired. Use [method register_server_bullet] instead for better performance with many simultaneous bullets.

method.name: register_server_bullet
method.description: Registers a server bullet type under [param type] using [param config] for rendering and collision settings. Server bullets are drawn with MultiMesh and use the physics server directly, allowing very large numbers of bullets with minimal overhead.

method.name: set_default_bullet
method.description: Sets the fallback [PackedScene] used when a TamaScript fires a bullet with a type not found in the registry.

method.name: get_player_position
method.description: Returns the current player position used for [code]aim[/code] direction calculations.

method.name: set_player_position
method.description: Sets the player position. Call this every frame so that [code]aim[/code] direction directives track the player correctly.

method.name: get_spawn_parent
method.description: Returns the [NodePath] of the node that spawned scene bullets are added as children of.

method.name: set_spawn_parent
method.description: Sets the node under which scene bullets are spawned. Defaults to the scene root when left empty.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the active [TamaContext]. Override this with a custom subclass to expose game-specific values (such as [code]time()[/code]) to TamaScript expressions.

method.name: set_context
method.description: Replaces the active [TamaContext] with [param v]. Set a custom subclass before any emitters start to make game-specific context functions available in TamaScript.

method.name: get_registry
method.description: Returns the [TamaBulletRegistry] that maps type names to bullet scenes and server configs.

method.name: set_registry
method.description: Replaces the active [TamaBulletRegistry] with a pre-configured one. Useful when you want to load a registry [Resource] from disk rather than registering types imperatively.

method.name: get_server_bullet_pool
method.description: Returns the internal server bullet pool node. Exposed for advanced use; most projects should not need to call this directly.

method.name: get_bullet_count
method.description: Returns the total number of currently active bullets across all types — both server bullets and scene bullets combined. Read-only; also accessible as the [member bullet_count] property.

members.member: The current player position. Update this every frame so that TamaScript [code]aim[/code] directions resolve correctly.
The node path under which scene-based bullets are added. Defaults to the scene root when empty.
The active context object queried by TamaScript expressions. Replace with a [TamaContext] subclass to expose custom values.
The registry that maps bullet type names to scenes and server configs.

When set to [code]0[/code] or greater, overrides the [member TamaServerBulletConfig.out_of_bounds_margin] of every registered server bullet type. A value of [code]-1[/code] (default) means each type uses its own margin.
The total number of currently active bullets — server bullets and scene bullets combined. Read-only.

signal.name: bullet_hit
